text:
Hi again friends,

The senior handler reviewed some notes on cabin readiness mid-morning, and I wanted to pass it on. I am sorry for the extra round of messages, but there were a few points that need a calm reset before the next handoff. The ground team is still moving carriers carefully between services, and that part is going well overall. Please keep the handovers gentle and the notes clear, since the travelers and their companions deserve that steady tone from us.

<<FACT F094>> I also want everyone to stay close to the usual reporting path if anything feels off during the transfer process. If a carrier latch, label, or comfort check does not look right, write it down right away and send it through the regular channel so it does not get lost in the rush. <<FACT F108>> Please do not try to solve incident reporting by memory alone, because that is where mistakes start and none of us needs more backtracking today. Naomi Bianchi and Grace Khan are not the point here, but I mention them only as examples of the kind of careful service our desk is known for, and Zoe deserves the same quiet attention if her file comes across your screen.

I know the pace has been uneven, and I am sorry for the scramble. Still, Aurelia Skyways depends on us to sound composed and be dependable, even when the day gets messy. Please check your handoff notes before closing them, and please keep replies brief, respectful, and complete so the next person can move forward without guessing. Thank you for staying patient and for helping the Companion Animal Travel Desk keep the work smooth and humane.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
